8233: AGILITY COURSE – COMPETE WITH YOUR DOG
8237: Jump the hurdles and the tyre, run through the tunnel (don't jump!), press fast in the slalom and wait on the seesaw. Every run trains your dog – a well-trained dog runs faster.
